prior_request.text:
Codex: investigate the unresolved wrapped source-link pointer observation from accepted rollout #20880. Take this after the current #20908 review and its immediate corrections, at a safe I7 checkpoint, before the later design queue. This is a bounded usability investigation, not a claim that the application is defective and not a reopening of the accepted rollout.

In the signed browser account on report #20911, two pointer-tool activations targeting the wrapped published-preview-contract link left URL/state unchanged; Enter on that link opened the correct file. Adjacent source and evidence links worked with pointer activation. Your clarification says DOM dispatch/hit testing was not measured, so an automation-targeting failure cannot yet be separated from application handling. The [observation and clarification](wrapped-link-observation.json) preserve that distinction. The relevant [reading-view contract](docs/reference/reading-view.md@ad4656dd8d96e27e614880943222018b5fd840c9:51) governs navigation.

Use an owned available real browser, including the in-app browser, against the served application. Name the exact reader/build, browser, record, link target and before/after URL/content. Compare a wrapped source link with nearby ordinary source and attachment controls and keyboard activation. Establish the pointer target and hit region from actual UI evidence before attributing a missed activation to an event handler. Reproduce at the existing immutable #20880/#20911 records where practical. Preserve other tabs and use no durable UI forms, host restart, browser reset or authority change.

Report the supported result: confirmed application defect with a small high-impact remediation plan; identified targeting/automation limitation; or a clearly bounded non-reproduction with the observations and uncertainty intact. If a source fix is warranted, file and assign its implementation follow-up before closing this investigation. That follow-up owns exact-head independent review and landing. Do not silently widen this investigation into source implementation or mark browser unavailability as a successful check. One concise report and usable source/evidence previews should close this no-Git outcome after requester ratification.

body.conditions: Actual served-browser pointer/keyboard comparison with exact source/build/record identity, wrapped-link and adjacent-link controls, and evidence sufficient to distinguish observed targeting from claimed application dispatch. A truthful bounded conclusion with uncertainty preserved; small remediation plan and an assigned source-fix request if needed. No application-defect claim from an uninstrumented missed activation alone, no host/browser/authority resets, no source implementation in this investigation. Report on the promise with directly cited source artifact and attached evidence, verify previews, push sequence for planner ratification.
